## Integration development

::: {.callout-note .example-author-notes}
### For course authors

The Python and mathematics examples load the selected consumer branches on this same examples
page. Python and mathematics use the shared feedback adapters. [Exact source revisions for this build](resolved-repos.json).
:::



::: {.callout-note .example-author-notes}
### For course authors

All shared-feedback development and acceptance checks live in this repository's
`examples.qmd` entry page and its topic includes. Add a new tab and topic include
for each subsequent integration.
Once an adapter works here, its changes can be propagated in a
separate consumer PR. Python and mathematics are the current consumer integrations.

For installation and copyable authoring examples, see the
[README and API guide](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/ai-feedback#api-quick-start).
:::
